Name: Black Fire-Mane Horse
Author: DarkKassanova
Description:
This mod replaces your ordinary brown horse with a black one...that's on fire!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ISS454j.png[/img]

[b][u]To install:[/u][/b]
1. Backup your horse.xnb file in Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals
2. Download and extract the new horse.xnb
3. Replace your old horse.xnb with the new one
